name: bakes-n-sale
description: Bakes n Sale — premium single-vendor bakery e-commerce platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bakery/shared && npm run build -w @bakery/api && npm run build -w @bakery/storefront && npm run build -w @bakery/admin
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bakery/shared && concurrently -k -n api,shop,admin -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @bakery/api" "npm run dev -w @bakery/storefront" "npm run dev -w @bakery/admin"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @bakery/shared && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
